metaDescription: Order custom direct to film apparel for vibrant, durable branding. Perfect for teams and events. Get a quote at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Direct to film (DTF) printing offers a versatile decoration method for custom apparel, allowing vibrant full-color designs on a wide range of fabrics including cotton, polyester, and blends. Unlike traditional screen printing, DTF requires no setup fees and is ideal for small to medium bulk orders with intricate artwork. Marketing directors and safety managers can achieve photorealistic logos or safety graphics that withstand repeated washing, making it a practical choice for uniforms, promotional tees, and event giveaways.
